title: Plan Change, Cancellation, Lapse and Reinstatement Terms of the Keyturn Shield Host Plans
content:
The periods and charges that govern moving between plans and the life of an enrolment are published plan by plan under the Keyturn Host Protection Plan.

### Moving between plans

| Plan | Notice for a plan change, calendar days | Effective period after notice, calendar days | Downgrade lockout, calendar days |
|---|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan | 30 | 30 | 180 |
| Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plan | 30 | 30 | 180 |
| Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan | 21 | 21 | 150 |
| Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan | 21 | 21 | 120 |
| Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan | 14 | 14 | 90 |
| Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan | 14 | 14 | 90 |

### The life of an enrolment

| Plan | Minimum enrolment, calendar days | Cancellation notice, calendar days | Reinstatement window, calendar days | Reinstatement fee, USD | Lapse after unpaid liability, calendar days |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan | 30 | 14 | 30 | 75 | 45 |
| Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plan | 30 | 14 | 30 | 75 | 45 |
| Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan | 45 | 14 | 45 | 95 | 60 |
| Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan | 45 | 21 | 60 | 125 | 60 |
| Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan | 60 | 21 | 90 | 150 | 75 |
| Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan | 90 | 30 | 120 | 200 | 90 |

### Notes

Notice for a plan change and the effective period after notice carry the same number of calendar days on every plan, 30 at the top of the ladder and 14 at the foot of it, but they are separately published figures. The downgrade lockout shortens as cover deepens, from 180 calendar days to 90. The minimum enrolment period runs the other way, from 30 calendar days on the Keyturn Shield 90 and 85 Host Plans to 90 on the Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan, and the reinstatement fee rises from 75 to 200 across the ladder.
